concept: Review and integration: responsibility as ownership of your part, not blame for everything
source_inspiration: original content — cumulative review, not sourced from any external text

exercise.reflection_prompt: Across self-management, group accountability, and owning your reactions — where do you have the most room to grow?
exercise.practice: Student identifies one real area of their life where more ownership would help

assessment.success_marker: student connects at least two of the three teen-stage scenarios into a coherent personal view
